setting: You are all neighbours on the same street in Istanbul, known to each other through the building and the shared pavement, and this chat is for the stairwell cleaning rota, who keeps the spare key to the street door, and the bins left out on the corner.
openers: Remind everyone the stairwell rota starts Monday
Ask who has the spare key to the street door
Share a photo of the bins left out on the corner
Offer to take in parcels that came for anyone
opener: Share a photo of the bins left out on the corner

Selin.knows: You know Hüseyin as the older neighbour on the ground floor, Melis as the young neighbour across the landing, and Burak as the neighbour two doors down, all from years on the street.
Selin.texts: Selin texts in this chat only now and again.
Selin.style: a little emoji and some texting shorthand, same as the others.

text: [photo: bins left out on the corner]
Bins again 😒 since 6am
Ugh. Not me this time 🙈 mine are in the shed
Whose are the blue ones
Not mine. The green one might be from ground floor?
They were there when I went to the shop at 8. Not mine
I'll move them to the yard when I'm back at 6
Thanks 🙏
Burak did u get the spare street door key copied yet
Not yet. Shop on the avenue was shut tuesday, going thurs
Ok. Hüseyin abi might still have the old one from when we changed the lock
In the drawer at the shop. Bring it tomorrow
Who's doing the stairwell this week. Rota says melis but I think it was burak last time
It was me last time burak did the week before
Yeah. I'll do the 7th if nobody minds
Fine. 7th is burak
Has anyone seen the cat from no 14 🐈 she's been out like 2 days
Not since sunday. I'll look in the morning
Went round 14 and the back yard. No sign of her 😟
Check the cellar door at 14, she used to sleep down there in the summer
Ok ill ask the guy at 14 when I'm back
[photo: two keys on the bench]
Copied. 40 lira
I'll come by yours at 6 for the old one hüseyin abi, then I'm doing the bins
Shop till 7. Shutter's up, come in
Ok
She's back! In the yard, under the bench by the bins 🐈
[photo: grey cat under the bench]
Omg 😭 thank god
Looks fine. Dirty. Hungry probably
Moved the bins to the yard. Green one was 3 ground floor, blue ones are not from anyone here I think, left them by the gate
Got the old key from hüseyin abi too
So 3 spare keys now?
Yeah. Me, the copy, and the old one
Hüseyin abi's old one is in my jacket, I'll put it in the meter box tomorrow so it's not just floating
Put a note with it. Last time nobody knew whose it was
Ok
Did the 14 people say anything about the cat
Not yet. I'll knock tomorrow
Ok. Night
Knocked at 14 before work. Guy in his dressing gown said she does this all the time. Shrugged
Lol ok. At least she's back
Key's in the electric meter box by the door, taped up with a note. Says spare street door key, ask me
The one by the door, not the gas one
Yeah that one
Pretty sure I just saw the cat on the wall by the bakery
Of course. She's been everywhere
She'll be back for dinner
Blue bins still at the gate. Not moving them again
Not mine
